title: Graduate Journeys: Experiences, Breakthroughs and Insights From Both Sides
description: This Free Roundtable gives the opportunity to hear firsthand from those who have made the journey from education to industry and those who build the pathways. It provides an opportunity to participate in an open discussion about those experiences and their lessons. In this open, organic conversation, the students and the path builders will share the positive impact of studio-led mentorship and dedicated incubation. We'll explore the gaps they found and how the support structures helped them overcome those challenges.
session_takeaway: Gain first‑hand knowledge from those that have made the transition from education to industry.
Learn how studios and programmes support graduates through mentorship and pathways.
Gain clarity on practical next steps for moving from education into professional practice.
